scenario: The negative half of the unresolved-path row. `type_error` is forbidden, which is the whole content: the same document, read one field over, DOES produce a TypeError, so a runtime that classified absence and wrong-type alike would pass the positive half and fail here.
rules_ds:
schema Payload scope logical:
    body: Json key

rule r:
    Payload p where p.body.missing is null
->
    log info "absent"
